ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC Ltd. announced the routine allotment of 16,637 new equity shares on September 21, 2026, due to the exercise of employee stock options under its ESOP Scheme 2021. This action marginally increases the company's paid-up equity share capital and outstanding shares, resulting in an immaterial dilution for existing shareholders. No material red flags or adverse impacts are identified in this standard regulatory disclosure.
